business_sli.title: Три SLI операций и цель SLO: окно 2 минуты
business_sli.query: label_set(100 * sum(increase(timepilot_tasks_created_total{sli_version="1",namespace="timepilot"}[2m])) / sum(increase(timepilot_task_attempts_total{sli_version="1",namespace="timepilot",operation="create"}[2m])), "indicator", "SLI create") or label_set(100 * sum(increase(timepilot_tasks_viewed_total{sli_version="1",namespace="timepilot"}[2m])) / sum(increase(timepilot_task_attempts_total{sli_version="1",namespace="timepilot",operation="view"}[2m])), "indicator", "SLI view") or label_set(100 * sum(increase(timepilot_tasks_updated_total{sli_version="1",namespace="timepilot"}[2m])) / sum(increase(timepilot_task_attempts_total{sli_version="1",namespace="timepilot",operation="update"}[2m])), "indicator", "SLI update") or label_set(vector(99.9), "indicator", "SLO target 99.9%")

probe_sla.title: Внешний пробер: SLI, цель SLO и порог SLA; окно 2 минуты
probe_sla.query: label_set(100 * sum(increase(timepilot_probe_requests_total{namespace="timepilot",result="success"}[2m])) / sum(increase(timepilot_probe_requests_total{namespace="timepilot"}[2m])), "indicator", "Probe availability") or label_set(vector(99.9), "indicator", "SLO target 99.9%") or label_set(vector(99), "indicator", "SLA target 99%")

compliance.title: Соответствие порогам на демонстрационном окне: 1 да, 0 нет
compliance.query: (label_set((100 * sum(increase(timepilot_probe_requests_total{namespace="timepilot",result="success"}[2m])) / sum(increase(timepilot_probe_requests_total{namespace="timepilot"}[2m]))) >= bool 99.9, "indicator", "SLO met on 2m window") or label_set((100 * sum(increase(timepilot_probe_requests_total{namespace="timepilot",result="success"}[2m])) / sum(increase(timepilot_probe_requests_total{namespace="timepilot"}[2m]))) >= bool 99, "indicator", "SLA met on 2m window")) and on() (sum(increase(timepilot_probe_requests_total{namespace="timepilot"}[2m])) > 0)
